##### Project general facts

Anantara Mina is a prestigious branded residential development by RAK Properties. A collaboration with the world-renowned Anantara Hotels & Resorts, this collection of ultra-luxury waterfront apartments and villas offers a rare blend of private homeownership with five-star resort services. The development is a testament to architectural excellence and seamless integration with its coastal environment.

Residents enjoy privileged access to a world of premium amenities, including a panoramic swimming pool, a state-of-the-art gym, a yoga studio, a private cinema, and an on-site restaurant. The experience is elevated by Anantara's signature hospitality, offering à la carte services such as in-home dining by award-winning chefs, personal concierge, valet, and buggy services. Each home is designed to balance privacy with the vibrant, resort-inspired lifestyle of Hayat Island, allowing owners to immerse themselves in a community of luxury and ease.

Inspired by the serene coastal surroundings, every residence at Anantara Mina features interiors curated with a contemporary aesthetic and elevated finishes. The design language reflects Anantara's refined ethos, blending sophistication with the natural beauty of the seascape. Options range from elegant apartments with generous balconies to expansive villas with private pools and boat docks, each crafted to be a sanctuary of light, space, and timeless elegance, where every detail is a celebration of waterfront living.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Hayat Island within the Mina masterplan, this exceptional location offers a sophisticated waterfront lifestyle on the unspoiled coastline of Ras Al Khaimah, just a short drive from Dubai. The community is framed by protected mangroves and lush parklands, providing a blissful escape into nature while offering convenient access to world-class amenities and attractions.

The location is distinguished by its enviable setting and future-facing appeal. Anantara Mina Residences sits within a stone's throw of the upcoming Wynn Al Marjan Island resort and is surrounded by an exceptional retail landscape, oceanfront dining, and scenic promenades. With renowned landmarks like the Anantara resort, Nikki Beach, and InterContinental nearby, it places residents at the heart of Ras Al Khaimah's most prestigious coastal destinations.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the pinnacle of branded luxury and island serenity, Al Marjan Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine natural beauty, world-class entertainment, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the UAE's most desirable addresses, offering a life where every day feels like a seaside escape.
